name: Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2 — a version word of its own
summary: Tempester Voice 1.5.1.1 with its own version reply (0xFE00: 0x17), so the machine and this app can tell it from 1.5.1.0 / 1.5.1.1 (0x16). Install Main Tempester 1.6.9.0 first.

changes: Reports its own version (Voice 1.7 on the System screen): the machine and this app can now tell it from Tempester Voice 1.5.1.0 and 1.5.1.1.
Install Main Tempester 1.6.9.0 BEFORE this Voice OS: with Main 1.6.7.0 or 1.6.8.0 the Release knobs fall back to 123 and a second full backup in a power-on skips the voice chips.

description: 1.5.1.1 with patch/voice/version_reply_1512.json in place of patch/voice/version_reply.json: the 0xFE00 reply becomes 0x17 (n°66), nothing else changes (the built image differs from 1.5.1.1 by one instruction word, the literal of the reply, verify.sh step 3c). Order: Main 1.6.9.0 (n°65) first. Main 1.6.7.0 / 1.6.8.0 test the exact word 0x16 for the Release lift (n°63) and the full-backup re-alignment (n°62): on them a 0x17 chip keeps the cap at 123 and is not read again in the same power-on (empty 78+k). 1.6.9.0 accepts 0x16-0x79 as Tempester Voice (every Tempester Voice from 1.5.1.0 on has the finite release 101-127 and the 0xF5nn dump pointer clear). Built and proved on the simulator. Brick window unchanged (pages 0-28). Installed on the six chips on 15/11/2026 after Main 1.6.9.0: message 45 reports six 0x17, pages 0-40 of each chip = this image, calibration page unchanged, two full backups in a row identical.
